title: Growing Up
deck: Southern Illinois sports roots: Cardinals baseball with my father and maternal grandfather, SIU basketball and football, family trips, and the earliest memories in the archive.

title: Undergrad
deck: The University of Illinois years in Champaign, with Illini football and basketball becoming the center of the sports calendar.

title: Grad School
deck: The University of Kansas years in Lawrence: Allen Fieldhouse, Kansas football, the Border War orbit, and a growing connection to Kansas City sports.

title: Baltimore / East Coast

title: Denver
deck: Denver becomes home base: getting swept up in the Nuggets and Avalanche, discovering Colorado soccer, using work travel to collect new venues, and beginning a new family chapter with Penny.
